thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 504s detected for Redwood Dedicated customers in us-west1 (control-plane + inference). Spike started ~03:07 UTC. Auto-page to oncall.
elena: Acked, oncall here. Seeing ~25% 504 rate across dedicated pools in us-west1. Latency also increased. Investigating.
samir: I can pull LB logs and LB config, starting now.
elena: @samir thx — run `gcloud compute forwarding-rules describe` for the affected region and grab LB backend health.
samir: Backend health shows ~70% unhealthy for backend-group-dedicated-uswest1, 502/504 from backends. Uploading tail logs.
jackie: CS ticket flood incoming, some customers reporting "model requests failing". I'm staging a status page update draft.
elena: Initial hypothesis: GCP load balancer or upstream NAT change coinciding with a rolling change in provider. @cloud-gcp can you confirm any maintenance or routing changes?
cloud-gcp: GCP support assigned case 123456789. Not seeing account-level maintenance in console, but we have a partial network fabric event in us-west1 starting 03:05 UTC affecting SNAT paths. Escalating now to Networking SRE.
nate: Mitigation options: 1) regional traffic reroute to us-west2, 2) fallback to multi-region routing for Dedicated customers, 3) increase retries/timeouts. Reroute will add latency but restore success.
elena: Start option 1 as quick mitigation. @samir prepare the routing change. @ops-sre-bot, execute runbook step: `reroute-dedicated-uswest1-to-uswest2` (dry-run then execute).
ops-sre-bot: Running runbook: `reroute-dedicated-uswest1-to-uswest2`
ops-sre-bot: DRY-RUN: validate route maps... ok
ops-sre-bot: EXECUTE in 30s.
elena: Jackie please hold the customer-facing note. Use template: partial outage for dedicated customers in us-west1, mitigations in progress, no data loss, updates every 20m.
jackie: Drafting. Here's the first-pass message — please edit:

```
We are currently investigating elevated request failures (504) affecting Dedicated customers in the us-west1 region. Our engineers are actively mitigating by rerouting traffic to an alternate region. We will provide updates every 20 minutes. We apologize for any disruption.
```

elena: Good. Add note about impacted customers: "customers pinned to us-west1" and provide workaround: "enable multi-region routing or use fallback region temporarily".
samir: Applying route change now: `rbacctl apply --file reroute-uswest1-to-uswest2.yaml` -> started
samir: Change applied. Monitoring request success rate.

ops-sre-bot: Route change propagated. Observed 20% drop in 504s after 90s, continuing to monitor.
elena: Good — begin gradual cutover for affected pools. @cloud-gcp keep us posted on fabric event.

cloud-gcp: Networking SRE reports a NAT capacity issue in a subset of nodes. They're adding capacity and evaluating failover paths. ETA unknown. Case 123456789 updated.
maria: Running smoke tests for model endpoints post-reroute. So far 95% success on small sample.

jackie: Status page update v1 posted: "Partial outage in us-west1 impacting Dedicated customers. Traffic rerouted to us-west2; partial recovery observed. Investigating root cause with cloud provider."

cs-notifications-bot: Notifying customers with active incidents pinned to us-west1. Template used: dedicated-us-west1-notify-v1.

elena: Keep an eye on tokenized cost — reroute may increase egress and compute. Set an alert for cost spike.
samir: Logs show some 504s still coming from older websocket connections pinned to the original node pool. We'll gracefully drain those nodes.

ops-sre-bot: Initiating instance-drain: backend-group-dedicated-uswest1 -> draining
ops-sre-bot: Drain completed for 3/6 instances, health improving.

cloud-gcp: NAT capacity increase applied in one subnet. We're verifying if that reduces retries. If not, we'll request a cross-zone fabric reroute.

nate: After reroute and drains, 504s down to ~4% — still above baseline but service usable. Recommend leaving reroute in place for 1 hour and schedule customer-facing update.
elena: Agreed. Jackie, post update with ETA and mention vendor escalation.

jackie: Posted update v2: "Recovery in progress. Traffic reroute reduced failure rates; root cause being investigated with our cloud partner. We will provide further updates every 30 minutes." Added link to support case 123456789 for partner contact.

elena: Time for partner comms template. Drafting an email to GCP escalation with logs and asks. Share please before I send.
samir: Logs + pcap extracts available at `s3://redwood-incident-archive/2014005678/` + LB trace ids. Also attaching `lb-backend-health.json` and `error-samples.log`.

elena: Draft email:

```
To: gcp-networking-escalations@gcp.com
Subject: URGENT: Production 504s affecting Redwood Dedicated in us-west1 — Case 123456789

Hi team,

We are experiencing elevated 504s starting ~03:07 UTC impacting Redwood Dedicated customers in us-west1. Mitigations in place: rerouted traffic to us-west2 and drained affected backend instances. We observe residual 504s on long-lived connections and suspect SNAT exhaustion/NAT fabric issue. Logs + traces: s3://redwood-incident-archive/2014005678/

Requested actions:
- Confirm whether there was a routing or NAT change around 03:00–03:10 UTC
- Validate SNAT capacity and any throttling on our project/subnet
- Recommend immediate fabric-level failover if available

Please escalate to Networking SRE and provide timeline.

Thanks,
Elena (SRE)
```

cloud-gcp: Confirmed escalated to Networking SRE; assigned internal ticket GCP-2024-9988. Requested packet captures and `x-forwarded-for` logs.

jackie: CS: Preparing templated replies for customers that request a deeper RCA. I'll include the mitigation steps and the fact we are coordinating with GCP.
maria: FYI load tests on routed region show slightly higher p95 latency (~80ms) but success rate acceptable.

elena: On-call handoff in 30m to @samir (next shift). I'll prepare handoff note with actions and outstanding asks to GCP.
samir: Ready to accept handoff. Outline please.
elena: Handoff note:
- Mitigation: traffic rerouted to us-west2 (stable)
- Remaining: residual 504s on long-lived connections, draining completed, GCP escalated case GCP-2024-9988
- Next steps: monitor for 2h, coordinate with GCP SRE on fabric failover, prepare RCA draft

elena: Handing off now. @samir you own updates and coordinate with CS for any customer follow-ups.
samir: Taking over. I'll set next update at +30m and post any new info.

ops-sre-bot: Reminder: Retain incident artifacts to `s3://redwood-incident-archive/2014005678/` and run `incident-summary-generator --id 2014005678` when closed.

cloud-gcp: GCP Networking SRE reports progress — implementing cross-zone SNAT redistribution; monitoring. ETA 20 minutes.

samir: Noted. Monitoring metrics: 504s trending to 1.2% -> baseline ~0.3%. If <2% for 15m, consider resolving incident with note.

jackie: Posted final customer update (v3): "Service largely restored. Residual errors may occur for pinned us-west1 sessions; we recommend reconnecting or switching to multi-region. Full RCA to follow once GCP confirms root cause."

elena: If GCP confirms fabric fix, we will remove reroute and do a controlled failback. Schedule a canary then full revert.

cloud-gcp: Cross-zone SNAT redistribution complete. Observed drop to 0.4% 504s after 8 minutes. Will confirm final verification in 10m.

samir: Good to see numbers near baseline. Initiating controlled failback to us-west1 for non-pinned sessions.

ops-sre-bot: Failback plan executed (canary) -> canary success. Proceeding to full rollback.

elena: All good — rolling back reroute now.

ops-sre-bot: Reroute removed. Post-rollback health: 504s at 0.35%, latency within normal.

jackie: Final status page update: Incident resolved — partial outage in us-west1 due to provider NAT capacity; traffic rerouted while partner remediated; service restored. RCA and timeline to follow.

cs-notifications-bot: Sent resolution notifications to affected customers.

elena: Closing notes: Schedule postmortem with GCP point-of-contact, include timeline and packet captures. Action items for us:
- Add automated SNAT usage alert per subnet
- Improve runbook to detect long-lived pinned connections and auto-drain
- Customer comms template update for provider escalations

samir: I'll own the SNAT alert and runbook update. Assigning PR after incident.
elena: Thanks everyone. Incident closed. :tada:

ops-sre-bot: Incident 2014005678 marked RESOLVED. Please file postmortem in `/incidents/postmortems/2014005678`.
